name: red-robot
description: Red Robot: a brutalist 3D mascot built entirely from a Blender Python script, with 9 web-ready animations.

scripts.build: flatpak run org.blender.Blender -b --factory-startup --python "$PWD/scripts/build_robot.py" && npm run optimize
scripts.optimize: gltf-transform resample export/red-robot.glb export/red-robot.web.glb && gltf-transform prune export/red-robot.web.glb export/red-robot.web.glb && gltf-transform dedup export/red-robot.web.glb export/red-robot.web.glb && gltf-transform quantize export/red-robot.web.glb export/red-robot.web.glb
